# American Mensa

> American Mensa is the largest national Mensa organization with 40,000+ members, providing membership pathways, admission testing, and intellectually stimulating events for gifted individuals.

American Mensa serves as the primary hub for joining and engaging with Mensa in the United States. The organization offers multiple admission routes through standardized test scores, direct testing, and youth programs, alongside flagship events like Annual Gatherings, Colloquium, and Mind Games competitions.

## Key Topics

- Mensa membership
- Admission testing
- IQ qualification
- Standardized tests (SAT, ACT, GRE)
- Gifted youth programs
- Annual Gatherings
- Mind Games competition
- Mensa Select awards
- Colloquium
- Member events
- Special Interest Groups
- Intelligence testing
- Community programs
- Mensa Foundation
- Practice tests

## Membership & Admission

- [How to Join Mensa](https://www.us.mensa.org/join): Main membership pathway explaining qualification requirements and join process
- [Take the Mensa Admission Test](https://www.us.mensa.org/join/testing): Primary admission testing pathway with local and private test options
- [Join Mensa Using My Past Test Scores](https://www.us.mensa.org/join/testscores): Guide to qualifying with prior standardized test scores from ~200 tests
- [Locate My Past Test Scores](https://www.us.mensa.org/join/testscores/locatescores): Instructions for locating and submitting past standardized test scores
- [Admission Retesting](https://www.us.mensa.org/join/retest): Information about retesting options and policies for membership qualification
- [Take the Online Mensa Practice Test](https://www.us.mensa.org/join/mht): Unofficial online practice test to assess Mensa qualification potential

## Special Programs

- [Mensa Gifted Youth Admission](https://www.us.mensa.org/join/gifted-youth-admission): Youth membership program and admission requirements for gifted children
- [March of Minds](https://www.us.mensa.org/join/march-of-minds): Mensa membership campaign and recruitment initiative with testing opportunities
- [Information for International Mensa Members](https://www.us.mensa.org/join/intlmembers): Guidance for international members transferring or joining American Mensa

## Events & Gatherings

- [Attend an event](https://www.us.mensa.org/attend): Hub for member events and intellectually stimulating activities
- [Annual Gatherings](https://www.us.mensa.org/attend/ags): Annual national conference and networking event for Mensa members
- [Colloquium](https://www.us.mensa.org/attend/colloquium): Annual intellectual forum exploring major societal issues with public debate
- [Mind Games®](https://www.us.mensa.org/attend/mindgames): Prestigious national board game competition and awards program
- [American Mensa National Events Calendar](https://www.us.mensa.org/attend/calendar): Searchable calendar of regional and national Mensa member events

## Awards & Recognition

- [Mensa Select® Games](https://www.us.mensa.org/attend/mindgames/mensa-select-winners): Archive of nearly 30 years of Mensa Select award-winning board games

## Core Pages

- [American Mensa](https://www.us.mensa.org): Homepage for American Mensa, the largest national Mensa with 40,000+ members
